_comment: Shop catalogues decided by hand, on top of the 51 measured in datos/npc_shops.json, which a
tool regenerates. A vendor written here sells what is written here, in this order, and a
price written here is the price of that item wherever it is sold.
An item with no price costs what datos/npc_shops.json says, or one kama.
GREMIA, the vendor outside the Guild Temple (NPC 7580 on 106168320). Measured in the capture
'comprar gremialogema-crear gremio-...': her kbd lists the guildalogem 1575 at 30,000, the
book 30810 'Acerca de los gremios' at 500 and the guild shield 13240 at 100,000. This server
sells the guildalogem for one kama so that anyone can found a guild; the other two keep the
price the capture shows.
She also sells the alliance gem 14290, 'Alianzalogema', for one kama: no vendor and no
recipe in the client's data gives it, and the Temple of Alliances'
door lets in only a character of level 50 who carries one. Without it nobody here could
found an alliance.
And the alliance's two potions, 14291 to change its name and tag and 14292 to change its
emblem, for one kama each: no vendor in the client's data sells them either. The same for the
guild's two, 13273 to change its name and 13270 its emblem.
And the alliances' tax collectors and prisms, which no vendor in the client's data sells: the ten
tax collector potions (27635, 27905-27912 and 14553, one per band of subarea levels) at the 100
kamas their templates carry, and the ten alliance prisms (27913-27921 and 14293) at their
templates' one kama.
And the seven tax collector resources (27929-27935, 'Clavos de recaudador' to 'Correa de
recaudador') at their templates' one kama: every item a tax collector wears is crafted from one
of them and runes, and nothing in the client's data drops or sells them.
HAL YLANZA (NPC 2142), at the Temple of Alliances (115083777), sells the same, through
'alsoSoldBy': the client's data gives him the buy action (11), as it does Gremia.
The Dream Market's two vendors, NEXT TO THE WELL OF DREAMS: Neru Stalar (7839) and Gobribe
(8000), whose catalogues and prices are the dofuspourlesnoobs guide's 'Songes infinis' (its
two vendor tables). They charge in tokens, datos/tiendas_en_fichas.json: Neru Stalar in
dream fragments (32080), what the end of a dream pays, and sells their bag of a thousand
(34274); Gobribe in those bags.
PEPITO (NPC 7030), at the Temple of Alliances: the pacifying crystal (27632), which the client's
help says is traded for nuggets with him (Translations 1149314). He charges in nuggets (14635),
datos/tiendas_en_fichas.json.
THE TROOL FAIR, for «La foire aux gobs» (1770, Dofus pour les noobs): Maxims (397) and his tofu hot dog
(6668), trool burger (6669) and wild sunflower fries (6670), what the hungry goblin eats; the ticket
seller (7519), the fair ticket (30328) Yova Etna asks for and the Gladiatrool one (30449); Rubén Paket
Hado (1573), the wrapping papers his workshop makes presents of (GiftWrapping).
